#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    int insertions = 0;
    int runLength = 0;
    char prev = 0;
    bool first = true;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (first) {
            prev = c;
            runLength = 1;
            first = false;
        } else {
            if (c == prev) {
                runLength++;
            } else {
                if (runLength % 2 == 0) {
                    insertions++;
                }
                prev = c;
                runLength = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!first && runLength % 2 == 0) {
        insertions++;
    }
    std::cout << insertions << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
